menlo-ventures._readme: Identity corrections for the Menlo run, re-applied on every rebuild. Fifty years of listings under four site generations plus a Form D sweep produce three kinds of duplicate: a RENAME (DriveCam/Lytx, Takipi/OverOps, Riffsy/Tenor, AnsibleWorks/Ansible, Media6Degrees/Dstillery, Abnormal Security/Abnormal AI), a LEGAL NAME on the filings against a trading name on the site (eShares/Carta, A Place for Rover/Rover, Social Bicycles/JUMP, Lumos Labs/Lumosity, Vital Labs/Riva Health, Kinetic Automation/Kinetic), and a LOGO FILENAME the 1998 era parser recovered as its own row (flexi, redbrick, MTILOGO). never_merge holds the two cases where the automatic name-variant merge joined companies two decades apart.

the site lists 'Axiom', the job board 'Axiom Math'

never_merge.reason: Alta (the 2023-founded AI style companion Menlo seeded in 2024) and Alta Analytics (a 1999-2000 listing on the Prior Investments page) are different companies twenty-four years apart; the name-variant merge joined them and pulled a 2000 wayback year and a 'defunct' status onto the modern row

Eve (the 2020-founded plaintiff-side legal AI platform) and eve.com (the 1999 beauty e-tailer on the Prior Investments page) are different companies; the merge pulled a 2000 wayback year onto the modern row
